title: RiX Numerics range provider descriptor
description: Portable portion of rix.numerics.range-provider@1. Runtime callables and the unforgeable host trust seal are intentionally not serialized by this schema; a trust string is descriptive, never authority by itself.

trust.description: Descriptive trust class. trustedCapability only certifies when the runtime also recognizes its non-portable host seal and exact callable binding.

facts.description: Optional trusted static fact family published beside the direct provider.

registration.description: Portable audit metadata for the host registration boundary, when present.
